practice: KARMA — Kept Action Receipts for Mutual Advantage

honesty.criterion: Claims about the action stay within cited evidence and declared limits.
honesty.baseline: No benefit is presumed when evidence is absent.
honesty.materiality: A changed claim is material only when its cited evidence or domain limit changes.

beauty.criterion: Form improves legibility or care without displacing evidence or accessibility.
beauty.materiality: Polish is material only when a declared audience can use the action more clearly or safely.

collaboration.criterion: Optional collaboration preserves consent, attribution, refusal, and independent judgment.
collaboration.baseline: Solo work and refusal are neutral, complete choices.
collaboration.materiality: Headcount and reciprocal praise create no fruit; only evidenced coordination effects matter.

understanding.criterion: The action leaves bounded, correctable understanding that another reader can inspect.
understanding.baseline: No transfer or lesson is presumed.
understanding.materiality: A lesson is material only when its invariant, predicted counterexample, contrasted fixtures, observed outcome, correction path, and domain limit are visible.

mutual-infrastructure.criterion: The action improves shared capability without creating a gate, debt, or hidden dependency.
mutual-infrastructure.baseline: Private convenience is not presumed to be shared infrastructure.
mutual-infrastructure.materiality: An improvement is material only when at least two declared beneficiary artifacts use one unit, none regress, one improves, and negative-control and declared-cost evidence remain linked.

fruit_states.kept: The precommitted criterion is structurally supported within its baseline and materiality rule.
fruit_states.open: The criterion remains unresolved; no benefit or fault is inferred.
fruit_states.not-applicable: The criterion is outside this action's declared domain.

evaluation_reasons.evidenced: Acyclic, role-compatible records structurally support the bounded predicate.
evaluation_reasons.unknown: Available evidence cannot establish the predicate.
evaluation_reasons.mixed: Independent evidence supports more than one bounded reading.
evaluation_reasons.circular: Cited evidence depends on itself, directly or transitively.
evaluation_reasons.out-of-domain: The criterion does not apply in the declared domain.

dispositions.fruiting: Expose expiring local affordance candidates for independently kept fruits; grant nothing.
dispositions.observe: Keep the action open without inference, pressure, or adverse consequence.
dispositions.compost: Expose only a privacy-scrubbed regression candidate for human review; the required repair declaration is not echoed.
dispositions.quarantine: Withhold candidates while an independent protected boundary is unresolved.

non_claims: This receipt describes one bounded action, never beings, identities, belonging, or moral worth.
Fruit states are contextual categories; they are never added, averaged, ranked, transferred, or used as a gate.
Rights, care, rest, compensation, access, and appeal remain independent of every fruit and disposition.
Recognition is opt-in, expiring, nontransferable, private by default, and any public-consent citation is structural only.
The tool validates declared structure, not truth, goodness, identity, consent, authority, current validity, or whole cost; it never executes, pays, mutates, publishes, contacts, or dereferences.
